note: Optional custom subtopics. Each belongs to exactly one common topic; an issue_id in the ranking is ISS-<topic>-<subtopic>. Membership is assigned by code from the enrichment label, so reranking needs no model.

subtopics.access.login_failure: Cannot log in or stay logged in; forced logouts; password reset fails
subtopics.access.account_locked_or_hacked: Account hacked, stolen, disabled, banned or locked; unauthorised account changes
subtopics.access.signup_verification: Signup, email/phone verification codes, linking Facebook/Google accounts
subtopics.usability.ads_frequency: Too many, too long, too loud or repeated ads interrupting listening
subtopics.usability.ui_navigation: Layout, redesigns, home feed, finding things, confusing navigation, design changes
subtopics.usability.library_playlist_queue: Managing playlists, library, liked songs, queue order, sorting, editing
subtopics.usability.controls_widgets: Buttons, gestures, lockscreen/notification controls, widgets, sleep timer, settings
subtopics.usability.other: Other usability issue not covered above
subtopics.playback.crash_freeze: App crashes, freezes, won't open, black screen
subtopics.playback.stops_pauses_skips: Music stops, pauses, skips or jumps by itself; songs won't play
subtopics.playback.connection_errors: 'No internet connection'/offline errors while online, failure to load or buffer
subtopics.playback.devices_bluetooth_car_cast: Bluetooth, car, Android Auto, Chromecast, Connect, smart speakers, watches
subtopics.playback.audio_quality_volume: Sound quality, volume levels, equalizer, audio glitches
subtopics.playback.performance_battery_data: Slow, laggy, battery drain, data or storage usage, overheating
subtopics.downloads.downloads_disappear: Downloaded/saved music or liked songs disappear or must be re-downloaded
subtopics.downloads.download_failure_offline: Cannot download, downloads stuck, offline mode not working
subtopics.downloads.other: Other download/offline issue (storage location, SD card, limits)
subtopics.catalog.missing_content: Songs, albums, artists or podcasts missing, greyed out, removed or region-locked
subtopics.catalog.search_discovery: Search results, finding music, browse/discovery features
subtopics.catalog.recommendations: Recommendations, algorithm, repetitive suggestions, Discover Weekly, autoplay/radio picks, shuffle repeating songs
subtopics.catalog.lyrics: Lyrics missing, paywalled or out of sync
subtopics.catalog.podcasts_audiobooks: Podcast/audiobook content, video podcasts, unwanted podcast promotion
subtopics.catalog.content_policy: Platform content decisions, artist bans, political or moral objections tied to content
subtopics.billing.free_tier_restrictions: Premium-only controls: forced shuffle, skip limits, can't pick songs, features moved behind the paywall
subtopics.billing.price_cost: Price too high, price increases, value for money, student/family plan pricing
subtopics.billing.charges_refunds: Unexpected, duplicate or post-cancellation charges, refunds, payment problems
subtopics.billing.premium_entitlement: Paid premium not activating, premium benefits missing, plan/trial not applied, cancellation difficulty
subtopics.support.unreachable: Cannot contact support, no human, no reply
subtopics.support.unhelpful: Support replies but does not solve the problem
subtopics.other.general_negative: General criticism or 'bad app' without a specific supported topic
subtopics.other.general_positive: General praise without a specific praised feature
subtopics.other.unrelated_unclear: Unrelated, meaningless, unsupported-language, or boycott-slogan text
